WEEK 6 RESULTS: Fronge def. Corbishley, 103.8-88.3; Charles def. Adam, 136.8-112.3; Brent def. Drew, 132.3-57.5 (BLOWOUT); Jake def. Shaq, 113.8-101.9; Kevin def. Wingard, 114.3-59.7 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Ryan, 149.1-122.1

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: CORBISHLEY HAS ZERO POINTS. ZERO. SHAQ IS AT 33.5 AND APEX IRON CAPITAL — SECOND IN THE STANDINGS, $123.78 ON THE EXCHANGE — IS SITTING ON A GOOSE EGG WHILE MONARCH WIDEOUT BANK PUTS UP A THIRD OF A HUNDRED BEFORE LUNCH. THIS IS THE QB DEPTH PROBLEM DRESSED UP IN A SUIT AND WAVING AT THE CAMERAS.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I went 1-1 on locks last week and I will survive it, but I need the record to reflect that my season mark is 8-4 and Terrence E. Odom is sitting at 5-7 with a straight face still collecting a check from this network. The standings exist. They are published. I have read them.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Five and seven. I know. I have been informed. I do not need Jay Kelpey, a man who also went 1-1 on locks last week, to narrate my season back to me every forty-eight hours.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Mitchum-Brent early window is the matchup of the morning and the Ledger is going to have thoughts — Deepwater hasn't scored yet, Obsidian is at 43.7, and the team that put up 149 last week is currently being outpaced by the franchise the market said couldn't buy a win projection. The board hasn't moved yet. It will.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Charles is 12-0 and playing a team with 567 points for and I called this matchup as the cleanest outcome on the slate — Crownline at $146.42, the market-cap leader, against a Wingard squad that just got blown out by 54 in week six. Sometimes the model and the scoreboard agree.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew is 0-12 with 547 total points. Adam is 2-10 and currently winning 19.9-6.3 in the void match. I locked Adam. My lock record is 2-0. I do not make the schedule, I just read it and profit.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Kevin cuts Ridley yesterday, cut Slayton two days before that, and is sitting in a 17-14 live game against Jake right now — that is three real-time decisions converging in a single matchup and I have been requesting a full segment on Redline's roster philosophy since week four. The request has not been acknowledged. I am 8-4 on the season and I will continue making the request.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: I know the power rankings aren't available this run and I know that means everyone is going to spend the next forty-eight hours telling me where I had them wrong anyway. Go ahead. I will wait. My season record is 7-5 and I locked Adam, who is currently leading the void match, so the methodology is holding.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Wingard added Josh Cuevas at TE yesterday, Jake added Tremble and Mooney, and Kevin is out here cutting veterans mid-week — three front offices all making noise on the waiver wire the same week they are either fighting for playoff position or watching it slip. The Ledger is keeping the receipts on all three.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Fronge is at 3.3 points in the morning window against a defending champion who is not interested in being gracious about it — Havana relocation, zero pick liquidity, FORG at $86.62 after a 2.3% slide, and now Ryan is putting up 30.9 before Fronge's roster has blinked. The regulatory flexibility is not helping the scoreboard.
